head: 7543ea329c70b78e2313a6b0deeff439fa2b0822
claim: Every BYOKit CLI prints its version for --version and in its help header (a build with unreleased changes says +dev (dev build)); the example PWA's sign-in page (its home page, a list of plans to sign in to) ends with 'byokit accounts <version>'; the herdr-kit phone page shows App and Host versions side by side and a hint when the host comes back on a different version; the Expo app's main screen ends with its app and kit versions

target.version: byokit at 7543ea32: built CLIs of @byokit/accounts, decide, dictation, write; examples/pwa; examples/herdr-kit; examples/expo release APK

steps.start: a person who cannot tell which BYOKit version a command, page or app is running
steps: the person runs byokit-accounts, byokit-eval, byokit-dictation-wer and write with --version and --help, and byokit-eval with no files
the person opens the example PWA and scrolls to the foot of the home page, light and dark, phone and desktop
the person pairs the herdr-kit phone page with the computer and looks at its foot
the computer restarts on a different version (99.0.0) while the phone page stays open
the person opens the Expo example on an Android emulator and scrolls to the end of the main screen, light and dark
steps.result: each CLI prints its package version (+dev (dev build) while unreleased changes are pending; byokit-eval plain); the PWA foot says byokit accounts 0.31.0+dev (dev build); the herdr-kit page says App 0.16.6 · Host 0.16.6, then App 0.16.6 · Host 99.0.0 with the hint to update the older one; the Expo screen ends with byokit example 1.0.0 · @byokit/accounts 0.31.0

verdicts.seen: Read all 11 entries. byokit-accounts --version and --help both show '0.31.0+dev (dev build)', and byokit-dictation-wer and write also show '+dev (dev build)'. Exit codes are 0. This matches the CLI part. The herdr-kit lines only reference screenshots and do not show the version screens, so they are not counted.
The footer reads 'App 0.16.6 · Host 0.16.6' side by side, and the page is 'Connected to Test computer'. No mismatch hint appears, which fits the matching-versions part.

The footer reads 'App 0.16.6 · Host 99.0.0', side by side, and below it is the hint 'The app and the host run different versions: update the older one, then reload.' This shows both the side-by-side versions and the mismatch hint.
The sign-in page lists plans such as 'Sign in with Ollama Pro'. Its footer reads 'byokit accounts 0.31.0+dev (dev build)'.
Desktop-width sign-in page with plan cards. The footer reads 'byokit accounts 0.31.0+dev (dev build)', which matches the sign-in footer part.

Read the build log. Its check lines 'ok: byokit example 1.0.0 · @byokit/accounts 0.31.0' under 'Night mode: no' and 'Night mode: yes' match the expected footer. The log is build output rather than a screenshot of the screen, so it is weaker evidence.
Light-theme Expo main screen. The bottom footer reads 'byokit example 1.0.0 · @byokit/accounts 0.31.0', which shows the app and kit versions.
Dark-theme Expo main screen. The footer reads 'byokit example 1.0.0 · @byokit/accounts 0.31.0', which shows the app and kit versions.
